findings.title: Existing Context Forge task responses can now crash
findings.description: `list_tasks()` now requires every JSON entry to contain `completed` and `total`. The previous client contract only required `index` and optional `files`, so older or otherwise valid `cf list tasks --json` responses missing either field raise `KeyError`. This breaks callers such as the new readiness source before it can produce a report. Treat these fields as optional if the CLI contract permits omission, or validate the response and raise a clear integration error.

findings.title: HALTED item resumes can leave the report showing the old outcome
findings.description: The executor replaces the report record only after the item body finishes. If the body raises a git/environment exception, `resume_item()` returns `HALTED` without rewriting the report, so the record remains flagged/not-run and does not show that this resume attempt halted. This conflicts with the report’s role in recording item-resume decisions and failures; persist the halted attempt before returning, or explicitly model the in-progress/halted state.
